intro: Across 31 articles spanning 12 April 2026 to 25 September 2026, ZCyberNews coverage of critical-infrastructure threats has tracked APT33, CL-STA-1062, and CyberAv3ngers, alongside the vulnerability CVE-2026-24032, rated CVSS 7.3. Reporting has centered on the energy, government, critical infrastructure, critical-infrastructure, and utilities sectors. The affected regions include the United States, Global, North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. Of the covered items, 15 are high severity, three are critical, three are informational, and one is medium. This archive collects that reporting in one place.
